posts.title: Vagrant cloud, box and insecure key pairs
posts.description: Problems Naive Solution Problems Vagrant leverages a insecure public/private keypair to create base boxes so that vagrant installations can automatically SSH into the boxes. By default, vagrant up generates a new public/private keypair locally and inserts this public keypair into the virtual machine.
